gloss: as before; as previously; same as before

definitions.gloss: as before; as previously; same as before
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something continues or should continue in the same manner as it was before a change or event. Slightly more formal than 今まで通り.

examples.japanese: {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}れた→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: After the illness, I was able to return to my life as before.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}{中|ちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: We are under renovation, but business is operating as before.

notes:
A combination of ⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧ (before, previously) and {通|どお}り (as, in accordance with). Used to indicate that something continues or should continue in the same way as it was before a change or event. Slightly more formal than ⟦{今|いま}まで{通|どお}り→今まで通り：22079_imamadedoori⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り + verb: to do something as before
- {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: the same ~ as before
- {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the same manner as before

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今|いま}まで{通|どお}り→今まで通り：22079_imamadedoori⟧ — as usual; as before (more everyday/casual)
- ⟦{従来|じゅうらい}{通|どお}り→従来通り：15458_juuraidoori⟧ — as conventionally done; as has been the case (more formal/institutional)
- ⟦{相変|あいか}わらず→相変わらず：01671_aikawarazu⟧ — as always; same as ever (can imply mild exasperation)
